test_Plan_execute: test the Plan class execute method to apply pending migrations in version order
test_Plan_apply: test the Plan class apply method to apply only new migrations not yet in the database
test_Plan_rollback: test the Plan class rollback method to reverse applied migrations
test_Plan_idempotent: test that Plan execute and internal operations are idempotent across repeated calls
test_Plan_saved_migrations_error: test that Plan raises SavedMigrationsError when previous migrations are missing from collected migrations
